text.en: Reviewers emphasize that anxious puppies and reactive dogs settle down nicely under Charlie's steady care. Multiple owners report that pets who previously struggled at other grooming salons leave relaxed, while cats were also handled safely during tidy-up and bath sessions.

Pet parents consistently celebrate the quality of grooming outcomes, remarking on how handsome and fresh their dogs appear after collection. Reviews mention precise nail trims on fussy animals, clean coat finishes on Shih Tzus and German Shepherds, and lasting pleasant scents.

Clients speak highly of Charlie's calm demeanour, communication, and clear advice regarding home brushing routines. Owners describe him as a natural with pets, remaining composed during tricky claw trims and answering owner questions with genuine care and attentiveness.

q.en: Does Cherry Spa accept cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers confirm that Charlie provides baths and tidy-up sessions for cats as well as dog grooming.

q.en: Can the groomer manage dogs that dislike nail clipping?

a.en: Multiple pet parents praise Charlie for successfully clipping claws on dogs that other groomers and vets could not manage.

q.en: What advice is given on coat maintenance?

a.en: Clients note that Charlie offers practical advice on suitable brushes and combs to keep coats healthy between appointments.
The salon is situated on Westerham Road in Leyton, East London.
